WITH compound AS (
    SELECT m.entry_id, m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
    FROM material_entry m
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    WHERE m.formula = 'Co3Ti'
    LIMIT 1
),
ref_energies AS (
    SELECT c.entry_id,
           SUM(comp.atomic_fraction * per.energy_per_atom) AS weighted_ref
    FROM compound c
    JOIN composition comp ON comp.entry_id = c.entry_id
    JOIN pure_element_reference per ON per.element_symbol = comp.element
    GROUP BY c.entry_id
)
SELECT c.formula,
       c.formation_energy_per_atom,
       r.weighted_ref AS ref_energy,
       c.formation_energy_per_atom - r.weighted_ref AS corrected_enthalpy
FROM compound c
JOIN ref_energies r ON r.entry_id = c.entry_id
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.is_stable, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < -0.3
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  c.element AS a_site,
  AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_formation_enthalpy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY avg_formation_enthalpy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Ni'
  )
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.1
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.element)
       c.element AS a_site,
       m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
ORDER BY c.element, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

WITH top_elements AS (
  SELECT
    m.chemical_system AS element_symbol,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.structure_id) AS polymorph_count
  FROM material_entry m
  JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
  WHERE m.number_of_elements = 1
  GROUP BY m.chemical_system
  ORDER BY polymorph_count DESC
  LIMIT 5
)
SELECT
  te.element_symbol,
  te.polymorph_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS l12_compound_count,
  AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_eform
FROM top_elements te
LEFT JOIN material_entry m
  ON (
    m.chemical_system = te.element_symbol
    OR m.chemical_system LIKE te.element_symbol || '-%'
    OR m.chemical_system LIKE '%-' || te.element_symbol || '-%'
    OR m.chemical_system LIKE '%-' || te.element_symbol
  )
  AND m.number_of_elements > 1
LEFT JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.entry_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY te.element_symbol, te.polymorph_count
ORDER BY te.polymorph_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    c.site_label = 'B-site'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT elem.element AS element,
       COUNT(*) AS stable_l12_count,
       AVG(elem.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_formation_enthalpy
FROM (
    SELECT regexp_split_to_table(m.chemical_system, '-') AS element,
           ps.formation_energy_per_atom
    FROM material_entry m
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
      AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
) elem
GROUP BY elem.element
ORDER BY stable_l12_count DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  cp_fh.value AS formation_enthalpy,
  cp_fh.unit AS formation_enthalpy_unit,
  cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc_fh ON calc_fh.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_fh ON cp_fh.calculation_id = calc_fh.calculation_id
JOIN calculation calc_bm ON calc_bm.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc_bm.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp_bm.value >= 150
  AND cp_bm.unit = 'GPa'
  AND cp_fh.property_name = 'formation_enthalpy'
ORDER BY cp_fh.value ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  tp.debye_temperature_k
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN thermal_property tp ON tp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY tp.debye_temperature_k DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN magnetic_property mp ON mp.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND mp.magnetic_ordering IN ('FM', 'ferromagnetic', 'Ferromagnetic')
ORDER BY ps.is_stable DESC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ABS(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, s.space_group
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS a_site,
       AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_eform
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM material_entry mp
      JOIN composition cp ON cp.entry_id = mp.entry_id
      JOIN structure sp ON sp.entry_id = mp.entry_id
      WHERE mp.number_of_elements = 1
        AND cp.element = c.element
        AND sp.volume_per_atom >= 15
  )
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY c.element
LIMIT 10000;
